title: Annotatio VI §.VII reply: Paul never teaches Impious eat Christ’s body — he guards against it
pass_a_gloss: Reply: The Apostle nowhere, even by one syllable, explained that Eating of Christ’s body is done by the unworthy — nay rather, when about to mention the unworthy’s eating in the Holy Supper, he with all solicitude and care bewares lest anyone opine that the unworthy eat Christ’s body.
pass_b_english: Reply: Paul nowhere, not by a syllable, teaches that the unworthy eat Christ’s body.
When he mentions unworthy eating in the Supper, he carefully guards lest anyone think they eat the body.
source_text: Resp. Apostolus nullibi, vel syllaba una, Manducationem corporis Christi ab indignis fieri explicuit, quin potiùs indignorum manducationem in S. Cœna commemoraturus, omni sollicitudine & curâ cavet, ne quis opinetur, indignos corpus Christi manducare.
notes: Paul never teaches Impious eat the body.
